# Webware ACL Memory

Tagline: Phases 1–3 are DONE and merged (bug fixes #13–#18, Http boundary moves, MessageBus read migration, guard rules); 100% line AND mutation coverage MET. #23 (inputfilter validate() migration) + #22 (centralized SystemMessage notifications) DONE + merged (PRs #30, #31). Remaining: Phase 4 incremental migrations (webware-migration) (blocked); `acl:init-db` — registered through webware-console's `ConsoleInterface` — already covers schema create + seed.

- #23 inputfilter validate() migration (2026-09-03, PR #30): ProcessRole/ProcessRule middleware migrated to the stateless `validate()` result API; `RuleDeleteFilter` added (DELETE rule flow); `parentId`/`assertions` drop `continue_if_empty` + `allow_empty` + `fallback_value` (empty auto-passes via `required => false`); messages read from `$filterResult->getMessages()` via the new `SystemMessageTrait::getSystemMessage(ErrorMessages)` (webware-core #14, merged).
- #22 centralized SystemMessage notifications (2026-09-03, PR #31): the 5 admin commands implement `NotificationCapableInterface` (readonly `$successMessage`/`$failureMessage` body properties); post-dispatch `$messenger?->success()/warning()` calls removed from Process*; `NotificationMiddleware` wired into the 6 write/delete routes after Process*; the validation-failure warning stays (pre-dispatch, not a CommandResult). 100% line + mutation coverage maintained (292 unit / 705 assertions; 12 integration / 63).
- Phase 4 direction (2026-08-28): migration tooling lives in `webware/webware-migration` (all migration logic + CLI commands) and `webware/webware-console` (TUI); those repos' constitutions/specs are the source of truth. acl ships `Migration016AclRole`/`Migration017AclRule` + base-role seed (Guest/Member/Administrator); IMS builds on those. Both repos are scaffolded (specify 1.0.1) with constitution PRs open; next step is /speckit-specify. The most important part (schema creation + base-role seed) is already covered by `acl:init-db`, which is registered through `webware/webware-console`'s `ConsoleInterface` (see InitDBCommand below); what remains is the incremental migration tooling.
- InitDBCommand (2026-09-01): webware-acl now ships its own DB initializer — `Webware\Acl\Console\InitDBCommand` (Symfony `acl:init-db`, `--drop` flag), `AclSchema`, `Console\Container\InitDBCommandFactory`, and `Console\Ddl\Column\Enum`. Creates `acl_role`/`acl_rule` with phpdb `Sql\Ddl` and seeds base roles (Guest/Member/Administrator/Developer chain) + Developer-owned `acl.manager.*` rules via `InsertIgnore` — no raw SQL. `webware/webware-console` added to require-dev with a VCS repo entry. Base seed uses acl's DEFAULT `admin_route_name_prefix` (`acl.manager.`); hosts that override the prefix (IMS uses `webware.admin.acl.manager.`) layer their own seed. `Enum` is a MySQL-dialect Ddl type missing from phpdb core — follow-up is to move it upstream into `php-db/phpdb-mysql` (separate session). Tests: unit SQL-render tests (real `PhpDb\Mysql\Sql\Platform`) + a live-DB integration test (`test/integration/Console/InitDBCommandIntegrationTest.php`) that runs `acl:init-db --drop` against the `mysql` compose service. `compose.yml` mysql now publishes 3306 to the host; phpunit.xml.dist carries DB env defaults (`TESTS_ADAPTER_MYSQL_*`, CI overrides hostname via `test-env-json`). 100% line + mutation coverage maintained (276 unit / 678 assertions; 12 integration / 63).

Only the coverage gate remains: run `composer test-coverage` + `composer mutation-test` and close any residual gaps.
- Shared test helper added: `test/unit/Support/PhpDbAdapterMock.php` (trait) — builds a PhpDb adapter mock, records SQL subjects, queues per-statement results, supports affected-rows / last-generated-value overrides and a throw-on-createStatement option. Reuse it for any DB-touching test.
- Shared integration helper: `test/integration/Support/FilterManagerFactory.php` — builds a real Laminas `InputFilterPluginManager` wired with `RoleDataFilter`/`RuleDataFilter` factories, the laminas-validator dependency config (so `ValidatorChainFactory` resolves), `AssertionManager`, and the `Assertion` validator registered via `setFactory` (NOT `setService` — `ValidatorChain::build()` with options bypasses shared services and needs a factory). Reuse for any real input-filter test.
- Test execution: unit tests run in the container (`docker compose exec -T tooling composer test`); host PHP is 8.4.0 but PHPUnit 13 needs >= 8.4.1, so NEVER run phpunit on the host. `docker compose exec -T tooling php vendor/bin/phpunit ...` works for targeted runs (the bare `vendor/bin/phpunit` exec fails on shebang).

  - Bug-tied lines CLOSED (bugs #15 + #17 fixed → `Validator\Assertion::isValid()` + `Entity\Rule::resolveType()` 100%).
  - Dead code removed: `Role\SingleRoleUserProxy::$id` set hook; `OverviewMiddleware` null/empty route-name guard + `normalizeRouteList()` flat branch; `Container\CommandHandlerMiddlewareFactory` DELETED.
  - `ProcessRoleMiddleware` invalid-input branch now unit-covered (`processPostSkipsDispatchOnInvalidInput()` added).
  - Mutation coverage (`composer mutation-test`): **100% MSI + 100% MCC** — MUTATION GATE MET (2026-08-28). 28 escaped mutants closed via test assertions; `EditRoleModalHandler` loop refactored to `array_find` (removed harmless `Break_`); `Acl.php` ancestor-walk loop got a no-progress guard (removes the `UnwrapSubstr` infinite-loop timeout); `infection.json5.dist` `threads` lowered `max` → `4` to remove concurrency timeouts.

  - `AccessDeniedException` (issue #14) now extends `\RuntimeException` directly (fatal fixed); it and `InvalidConfigException` have 0 executable lines (no line-coverage impact).
- Bugs #13–#18 are FIXED and merged (2026-08-28); the bug entries below are historical reference.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #13): `RuleRepository::findByRoleAndResource()` calls `json_decode($row['assertions'], true)` with no null guard → TypeError on NULL assertions column under strict_types. `fetchAll()` guards correctly. Fix post-refactor per CON-001.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #14): `Exception\AccessDeniedException` extends `Exception\RuntimeException` but `RuntimeException` is `final` → fatal "cannot extend final class" on autoload. Fix post-refactor (drop `final` or implement `ExceptionInterface` directly).
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #15): `Validator\Assertion` declares `$missingAssertion`/`$invalidType` as `private`, but Laminas `messageVariables` reads them from the `AbstractValidator` parent scope → every `error()` throws `Error`; the validator can never return false. Fix: make them `protected`.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #16): `Validator\Assertion::__construct` reads `$options['nullable']` with no null guard → TypeError on null/partial options.
- CONFIRMED BUG (issue #18): `InputFilter\RuleDataFilter` adds `type` with only a `Filter\ToEnum` (no validator); `ToEnum` is case-sensitive and returns unrecognized values unchanged, so any non-`'Allow'`/`'Deny'` value passes `isValid()` and then TypeErrors in `SaveRuleCommand`/`UpdateRuleTypeCommand`. Production templates submit correct case, so this is input-robustness only; the old ui-mockup used lowercase. Fix post-refactor (add enum validator and/or case-insensitive mapping).
- LATENT (now issue #17): `Entity\Rule` constructor promotes `RuleType $type` (not `string|RuleType`), so `populate(['type' => 'Deny'])` would TypeError; the `resolveType()` string branch is effectively unreachable. Note it, don't fix (CON-001).
- RISK-007: ProcessRuleMiddleware (processPatch/processDelete CommandResult issues) + RuleFilter readonly-assignment bugs may be stale tracking. Move classes INTACT (CON-001); characterization tests confirm whether the bugs persist; fixes land in a separate, clearly-marked post-refactor effort.
- RISK-003: RESOLVED (2026-08-28) — the boundary violations were migrated in Phase 3: `AddRoleModalHandler`/`EditRoleModalHandler`/`RoleListHandler` now read via `FetchAllRoles`; `OverviewMiddleware` via `FetchAllRules`.
- RISK-004/RISK-006 (decided): acl-local MessageBus classes UNWIRED from `getBusConfig()` (pipeline now uses vendor `MessageHandlerMiddleware`); the classes remain physically present — removal is deferred to webware-acl #22. ALL reads go through the bus, including `Acl::load()` — no DI cycle while the ACL-enforcing middleware is unwired.
- Phase 2 namespace map (TASK-005, decided): `Admin\Middleware\*` → `Http\Admin\Middleware\*`; `Admin\RequestHandler\*` → `Http\Admin\RequestHandlers\*`; root `Middleware\*` (AclMiddleware, AuthorizationMiddleware) → `Http\Middleware\*`; `RequestHandler\ForbiddenHandler` → `Http\RequestHandlers\*`. Class names unchanged; no BC aliases; every move tracked in IMS issue #30. `Http\RouteResource*` stays under `Http\`; `Admin\Dashboard\*` stays (TASK-007 resolved).
- acl entities (`Role`, `Rule`) now use the PhpDb `RowPrototypeInterface`/`RowPrototypeResultSet` contract (usermanager-aligned); `RoleRepository`/`RuleRepository` hydrate via `RowPrototypeResultSet`. `SingleRoleUserProxy` updated for the new usermanager `UserInterface` (throws-only methods return `never` with `@throws Exception`). Legacy `withRowData()` proxies kept on the entities.
- acl composer.json no longer requires webware/webware-resultset; the VCS repository entry was removed and composer.lock refreshed (resolved usermanager 0.1.x-dev 29d8fcd).
